beschreibung: A pedestrian shopping street in a small German town on a bright afternoon, view along the street. Five people walk slowly towards the camera at different distances, their faces clearly visible: a couple in their forties, a young woman with a backpack, an older man with a flat cap, a teenager with headphones. On the left a white delivery van is parked at the kerb with its front facing the camera; its licence plate is a white German plate with a blue EU band and the black text "XZ-DL 314". Shop windows, planters and paving stones. Realistic documentary footage filmed with a fixed camera on a tripod at eye level, natural daylight, sharp focus, ordinary people in everyday clothes walking at a normal pace. The camera remains fixed throughout.

A small German town square with a stone fountain. Two women stop in the foreground and talk to each other, their faces turned towards the camera; behind them people cross the square from left to right and from right to left. A bronze statue of a seated man stands motionless on a pedestal in the middle ground. On the right a red hatchback is parked with its rear towards the camera; its licence plate is a white German plate with a blue EU band and the black text "QM-AT 1907". Realistic documentary footage filmed with a fixed camera on a tripod at eye level, natural daylight, sharp focus, ordinary people in everyday clothes walking at a normal pace. The camera remains fixed throughout.

A tram stop in a German city in the late afternoon. A man in a grey coat and a woman with a pushchair wait at the stop and look towards the camera; a man with a briefcase walks past close to the camera; further back a few people walk along the pavement. A dark blue estate car is parked in the foreground on the right with its front towards the camera; its licence plate is a white German plate with a blue EU band and the black text "YJ-RS 220". Realistic documentary footage filmed with a fixed camera on a tripod at eye level, natural daylight, sharp focus, ordinary people in everyday clothes walking at a normal pace. The camera remains fixed throughout.
